verdict.rationale: smolagents ships CLI utilities (`smolagent`, `webagent`) for running agents without boilerplate, and `from_hub`/`push_to_hub` let you pull a pre-built agent from the Hub, which loosely resembles template-based scaffolding, but there is no documented 'init' or project-template command that scaffolds a new agent project structure in one step. Missing for 10: an explicit scaffold/init CLI command or project template generator, and any hands-on/community confirmation of one-command project creation.
